Definition: The name given to an item in the scene editor. It is shown in the scene tree and can be changed in the Properties panel. Code uses it to find the item.
A value meaning "nothing here". A find action gives back undefined when no item has the name it was asked for.
An object that is told when something happens, such as a key being pressed.
A number that says which key was pressed. KeyboardEvent has a name for each one, such as LEFT or PAGE_UP.
Code that can be added to an item to make it do something every frame, such as move when keys are pressed.
A ready-made behavior that moves an item with the keyboard. Quorum has MovementBehavior2D and MovementBehavior3D.
